plist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: To check it is you before showing what is stored.

watchos.unsupported: a watch has no biometric sensor, and LocalAuthentication says so in the header: LAPolicyDeviceOwnerAuthenticationWithBiometrics is API_UNAVAILABLE(watchos), and so are biometryNotAvailable, biometryNotEnrolled and biometryLockout. What watchOS does have is the passcode and, from watchOS 9, LAPolicyDeviceOwnerAuthenticationWithWristDetection, which answers 'this watch is on the wrist it was unlocked on' -- a real check, but not a biometric one, and returning success from it under a method called authenticate would be a lie about what was verified. To protect a secret on a watch, use @angular-native/plugin-keychain: its watchOS half stores through the same Keychain Services and can bind an item to the device passcode.
